about.title: About SOJIF Consulting
about.subtitle: A firm of excellence serving African businesses
about.historyP1: Founded in Dakar, SOJIF Consulting was born from the conviction that African businesses deserve world-class support, adapted to their realities.
about.historyP2: Under the leadership of Fatou Guewel MBAYE, the firm has developed a unique approach combining legal, financial and technological expertise to offer integrated and tailored solutions.
about.missionDesc: Structure and strengthen the performance of African businesses through high-level multidisciplinary expertise in law, finance and development.
about.visionDesc: Become the reference firm in West Africa for strategic and operational business support, combining excellence, innovation and local presence.
about.value1Desc: We strive for excellence in every intervention, every recommendation, every solution.
about.value2Desc: Transparency and ethics are at the heart of all our professional relationships.
about.value3Desc: We constantly innovate to offer solutions adapted to modern challenges.
about.value4Desc: We are fully committed to the success of each of our clients.
about.directorBio: Expert in business structuring and strategic consulting, Fatou Guewel MBAYE leads SOJIF Consulting with an ambitious vision for supporting African businesses.
